cork.definition:
n. outer bark of the cork oak; used for stoppers for bottles etc.
n. a port city in southern Ireland
n. the plug in the mouth of a bottle (especially a wine bottle)
v. close a bottle with a cork
cork.translation:
n. 软木塞, 软木树, 软木
[化] 木栓

cork extractor.translation: [化] 拔塞器; 拔软木塞器

cork press.translation: [化] 压塞器; 压软木塞器

cork presser.translation: [化] 压塞器; 压软木塞器

cork puller.translation: [化] 拔塞器; 拔软木塞器

cork up.translation: 封堵, 封锁, 抑制

corkage.definition: n. a charge added at a restaurant for every bottle of wine served that was not bought on the premises
corkage.translation: n. 拔瓶塞, 开瓶费

corkboard.definition: n. a heat-insulating building material consisting of cork granules that are made into sheets by compressing and baking
corkboard.translation: n. (绝热)软木板,软木公告板

corked.definition: s. (of wine) tainted in flavor by a cork containing excess tannin
corked.translation: a. 塞子塞住的, 用软木塞炭涂黑的, 有塞子气味的, (美)(非正式)喝醉酒的

corker.definition:
n. (dated slang) a remarkable or excellent thing or person
n. a machine that is used to put corks in bottles
corker.translation:
n. 塞瓶塞的人
[建] 压塞机, 木塞压紧机

corkers.definition:
plural of corker
n. (dated slang) a remarkable or excellent thing or person
n. a machine that is used to put corks in bottles
corkers.translation:
(corker 的复数) n. 塞瓶塞的人
[建] 压塞机, 木塞压紧机

corkery.translation: [人名] [爱尔兰姓氏] 科克里盖尔语姓氏的英语形式，来源于人名，含义是“紫色”(purple)

corkin.translation: [人名] [爱尔兰姓氏] 科金 Corkery的昵称

corkiness.definition: n. The quality of being corky.
corkiness.translation: n. 软木似的；喜不自禁

corking.definition:
v close a bottle with a cork
v stuff with cork
s very good
corking.translation:
a. 很好的
adv. 非常地

corkran.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 科克伦 Corkery的昵称

corks.definition:
n outer bark of the cork oak; used for stoppers for bottles etc.
n (botany) outer tissue of bark; a protective layer of dead cells
n a port city in southern Ireland
n the plug in the mouth of a bottle (especially a wine bottle)
n a small float usually made of cork; attached to a fishing line
v close a bottle with a cork
v stuff with cork

corkscrew.definition:
n. a bottle opener that pulls corks
v. move in a spiral or zigzag course
corkscrew.translation:
n. 拔塞钻
a. 螺旋形的
vt. 硬拉出, 探听
vi. 曲折行进

corkscrewed.definition: v move in a spiral or zigzag course
corkscrewed.translation: v. 硬拉出, 探听, 作螺旋状前进( corkscrew的过去式 )

corkscrewing.definition: v move in a spiral or zigzag course
corkscrewing.translation: v. 硬拉出, 探听, 作螺旋状前进( corkscrew的现在分词 )

corkscrews.definition:
n a bottle opener that pulls corks
v move in a spiral or zigzag course
corkscrews.translation: n. 开塞钻, 螺丝锥( corkscrew的名词复数 )

corkwood.definition: n. very small deciduous dioecious tree or shrub of damp habitats in southeastern United States having extremely light wood

corky.definition: s (of wine) tainted in flavor by a cork containing excess tannin
corky.translation: a. 软木的, 活泼的
